paper.title: Muzzle the Shuttle: Efficient Compilation for Multi-Trap Trapped-Ion Quantum Computers
paper.what: QCCDSim's six-trap line (L6) with 15 ions per trap (+2), five benchmarks; the metric is the number of shuttles (adjacent-trap moves).
